notes: Interface for GL/native index (element array) buffer wrappers implemented by GlElementArrayBuffer and NativeVertexBuffer. GlElementArrayBuffer.method33 returns anInt1929 (the GL buffer object id) and is used as glBindBufferARB(GL_ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER, byteArrayCodec.method33(-23923)) in OpenGlRenderer.kt:2436. The `i` param is always called with the same magic constant (-23923) at every call site and only triggers an opaque-predicate side effect (calling method35 with dummy args) when it doesn't match — classic decoy/self-check param, not meaningful data. NativeVertexBuffer's override just returns a constant (92 or 0) since it has no real GL buffer id.

Returns the GL index/element type constant (e.g. 5123 = GL_UNSIGNED_SHORT) stored by method35's `i` param; used in OpenGlRenderer.kt:1084 as the `type` argument to glDrawElements. `i` param is again always called with the same constant (-5711) and is an opaque-predicate decoy triggering a call to method35 with dummy args when unequal.
